args.title: Tamarack Components: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Summary
args.body:
Three-bullet combined summary of the Tamarack Components newsletter, its linked article, and the article's companion piece:

• Newsletter (Tamarack Components, "Warehouse automation in 2026"): This week's edition highlights warehouse automation trends for 2026, linking to the full article on the Tamarack blog and promoting a related webinar.

• Article ("Warehouse automation in 2026"): Autonomous carts drove an 18% increase in pick rates, but integration efforts took twice as long as originally planned.

• Companion piece (Tamarack Insights): The largest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks.

Note: The newsletter included a webinar seat-holding link that would submit a work email address as an attendee parameter; it was not used since registering for the webinar was not requested.
